title: Edit Distance
statement_short: Given two strings word1 and word2, return the minimum number of operations required to convert word1 to word2\. You can insert, delete, or replace a character.
constraints: 0 <= word1.length, word2.length <= 500, word1 and word2 consist of lowercase English letters
hint: Word lengths up to 500 allow 2D DP matrix matching min operations across character prefixes.
keywords: insert, delete, or replace a character
why_not: Right: 2D DP computes Levinshtein distance matrix matching insert, delete, and replace subproblems in O(m \* n) time and O(n) space. Not Two Pointers: Scanning pointer pairs cannot handle multi-operation insertions and deletions without state grid transitions. Not Greedy: Local character matching choices fail because early edits impact global edit distance costs. Not Backtracking: Recursive branch exploration without memoization causes TLE with 3^(m+n) exponential complexity.
